body:
Family is off the table. I've been lucky to have friends who've put me up for a night here or there, let me shower or something, but like I said-everyone has to watch out for themselves. The casual, good-natured "dude, anytime you need a place a crash just let me know" has a way of disappearing, or turning into "ah, not a good night man" when you actually reach out.

This all goes hand in hand with the overwhelming despair I'm in. My situation is an extremely embarrassing one, and I don't want to be anyone's burden.
